key_patterns: kaisel routes: `final class FooRoute extends AppRoute { const FooRoute(); }` with optional fields + List<Object?> get props override. KaiselRouterConfig<AppRoute>(initial: const HomeRoute(), builder: (ctx, route) => switch(route){...}). Navigation: `context.router<AppRoute>().push(PostRoute(postUrl: url))`. Signals: `final mySignal = signal<T>(initial)` from signals_core, read with `.value`, mutate with `.value = newValue`. CubitSignal: `class MyCubit extends CubitSignal<State> { MyCubit() : super(initialState: ...); void doThing() => emit(newState); }`. BlocSignalBuilder in widgets for reactive rebuilds.
